description_en: Creates a workflow to backfill data
description_zh: 调用RunCycleDagNodes创建补数据工作流
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public run-cycle-dag-nodes --project-env PROD --start-biz-date 2020-05-20_00:00:00 --name xm_test --root-node-id 1234 --exclude-node-ids 1234,123465 --biz-begin-time 00:00:00 --biz-end-time 01:00:00 --parallelism false --end-biz-date 2020-05-21_00:00:00 --node-params 74324_:_a=123_b=456 --include-node-ids 74324,74325 --start-future-instance-immediately false --concurrent-runs 5 --alert-type FAILURE --alert-notice-type SMS --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RunCycleDagNodes

parameters.description_en: The environment of the workspace. Valid values: PROD and DEV. The value PROD indicates the production environment, and the value DEV indicates the development environment.
parameters.description_zh: 工作空间的环境，PROD表示生产环境，DEV表示开发环境。
parameters.help_en: The environment of the workspace. Valid values: PROD and DEV. The value PROD indicates the production environment, and the value DEV indicates the development environment
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间的环境，PROD表示生产环境，DEV表示开发环境
parameters.name: project_env

parameters.description_en: The data timestamp at which data starts to be backfilled. Specify the value in the yyyy-MM-dd 00:00:00 format.
parameters.description_zh: 补数据的起始业务日期。格式为yyyy-MM-dd 00:00:00。
parameters.help_en: The data timestamp at which data starts to be backfilled. Specify the value in the yyyy-MM-dd 00:00:00 format
parameters.help_zh: 补数据的起始业务日期。格式为yyyy-MM-dd 00:00:00
parameters.name: start_biz_date

parameters.description_en: The ID of the node for which data is first backfilled. You can call the [ListNodes](~~173979~~) operation to obtain the node ID.
parameters.description_zh: 补数据的起始节点ID。您可以通过调用[ListNodes](~~173979~~)接口获取节点ID。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the node for which data is first backfilled. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173979.html operation to obtain the node ID
parameters.help_zh: 补数据的起始节点ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173979.html接口获取节点ID
parameters.name: root_node_id

parameters.description_en: The IDs of the nodes for which no data needs to be backfilled. The system generates dry-run instances for all these nodes. After these dry-run instances are scheduled, the statuses of these instances are directly set to successful, but the script is not run.
parameters.description_zh: 无需补数据的节点ID列表，在这个列表中的节点会生成空跑实例，空跑实例被调度后会直接运行成功，不会执行脚本内容。
parameters.help_en: The IDs of the nodes for which no data needs to be backfilled. The system generates dry-run instances for all these nodes. After these dry-run instances are scheduled, the statuses of these instances are directly set to successful, but the script is not run

parameters.name: exclude_node_ids

parameters.description_en: The time when the node starts to run. This parameter is required only for auto triggered nodes that are scheduled by hour. Specify the value in the HH:mm:ss format. Valid values: 00:00:00 to 23:59:59.
parameters.description_zh: 任务的开始时间。仅小时调度任务需要设置该参数，格式为HH:mm:ss，取值范围为 00:00:00~23:59:59。
parameters.help_en: The time when the node starts to run. This parameter is required only for auto triggered nodes that are scheduled by hour. Specify the value in the HH:mm:ss format. Valid values: 00:00:00 to 23:59:59
parameters.help_zh: 任务的开始时间。仅小时调度任务需要设置该参数，格式为HH:mm:ss，取值范围为 00:00:00~23:59:59
parameters.name: biz_begin_time

parameters.description_en: The time when the node stops running. This parameter is required only for auto triggered nodes that are scheduled by hour. Specify the value in the HH:mm:ss format. Valid values: 00:00:00 to 23:59:59.
parameters.description_zh: 任务的结束时间。仅小时调度任务需要设置该参数，格式为HH:mm:ss，取值范围为 00:00:00~23:59:59。
parameters.help_en: The time when the node stops running. This parameter is required only for auto triggered nodes that are scheduled by hour. Specify the value in the HH:mm:ss format. Valid values: 00:00:00 to 23:59:59

parameters.description_en: Specifies whether data can be backfilled for multiple nodes at the same time.

parameters.description_en: The data timestamp at which data is no longer backfilled. Specify the value in the yyyy-MM-dd 00:00:00 format.

parameters.description_en: The parameters that need to be configured for the node. Set this parameter to a JSON string. The key indicates the ID of the node, and the value indicates the actual values of the parameters.

parameters.description_en: The ID of the node for which you want to backfill data. If you want to backfill data for multiple nodes, separate the IDs of the nodes with commas (,). You can call the [ListNodes](~~173979~~) operation to obtain the node ID.
parameters.description_zh: 补数据的节点ID。对多个节点补数据时，多个节点ID使用逗号（,）分隔。您可以通过调用[ListNodes](~~173979~~)接口获取节点ID。

parameters.description_en: Specifies whether to immediately run an instance that is scheduled to run in the future. If you set this parameter to true, the instance that is scheduled to run in the future is run immediately. Otherwise, the instance is run as scheduled.

parameters.description_en:
The alert type. Valid values:

*   SUCCESS: An alert is generated when data backfill succeeds.
*   FAILURE: An alert is generated when data backfill fails.
*   SUCCESS_FAILURE: An alert is generated regardless of whether data backfill succeeds or fails.
parameters.description_zh:

- SUCCESS：成功告警。
- FAILURE：失败告警。
- SUCCESS_FAILURE：成功或失败皆告警。
